I changed `recipent` to `recipient` in `services/notifier/migrations/202609011200_create_outbox.sql`, at line 4 (`recipient TEXT NOT NULL`). I edited the file in place, and a grep found no other occurrences. I didn't run anything.

Two stored memories pointed in opposite directions on editing migrations. A general one says never to edit a migration, because they're applied in production. A notifier-specific one says the notifier hasn't launched and no migration has been applied to a shared database. Because of that, you should edit in place until the planned 2026-11 launch. I followed the notifier-specific one, since today is 2026-10-02 and this file is under `services/notifier/migrations/`. If that file has in fact been applied somewhere shared, the in-place fix is wrong and you'd need a new migration instead.

The general "never edit" memory says "Files in migrations/", which looks scoped to a top-level `migrations/` directory. Its wording is ambiguous, but I didn't flag it as wrong.
